entities.summary: Aleksandr Aleksandrovich Yezhevsky was a Soviet bureaucrat who was minister of tractor and agricultural machinery of the Soviet Union (1980–1988). He was born in Tulun, in the Siberian Irkutsk Governorate of the Russian Empire.
